description: Set the shared Email to Letter and Email to Postcard workspace enabled flag, per-mailing/daily/monthly budgets in USD cents and daily mailing-count limit. The API field names perLetterCents and dailyLetters apply to both letters and postcards. Production key required. Enabling may resume previously authorized autosend; obtain approval for spending limits. No automatic card charges.
name: update_email_letter_settings
title: Update Email Letter Settings
